PageBreak.name: Page break
PageBreak.description: Hidden on screen. Inserts a page break when the form is printed.

breakBefore.name: Break before
breakBefore.description: The CSS break-before rule used when printing

breakAfter.name: Break after
breakAfter.description: The CSS break-after rule used when printing

breakInside.name: Break inside
breakInside.description: The CSS break-inside rule used when printing

PrintSettings.name: Print settings
PrintSettings.description: Hidden on screen. Adds a print header, footer, and optional page numbers.

header.name: Header
header.description: The printed header. Use {page} and {pages} for page numbers

footer.name: Footer
footer.description: The printed footer. Use {page} and {pages} for page numbers

headerAlign.name: Header align
headerAlign.description: The header position in the page margin

footerAlign.name: Footer align
footerAlign.description: The footer position in the page margin
